## Plugin reference

- Description: Ask Sonnet in the Places search bar, server half: the Places task category, the places.ask scratch profile (CLAUDE.md = the map's area and the user's clock; no shell, no exit_clean, so the run stays repliable), its places_search_text tool (Google Text Search biased to the launch's map area, on the search bar's downgrade ladder read server-side) and places_show_picks (the thread's result, refusing any id the run's searches never returned), and the conversations_ext_places_ask side-table of the Google candidates each run has seen, served lookup-only as places.ask.candidates (what a pick's card is drawn from).
- Server:
  - Contributes:
    - `taskCategory` "places"
    - `resource.declare` "places.ask.candidates:rows"
  - Uses:
    - `apps/places/places-core.searchPlaces`
    - `conversations/workspace.defineScratchProfile`
    - `conversations/workspace.ScratchProfile`

    - `infra/entity-extensions.defineExtension`

    - `network/live.serveCollection`
    - `tasks/task-category.TaskCategory`
    - `tasks/tasks-core._conversations`
  - DB schema: `plugins/apps/plugins/places/plugins/ask/server/internal/tables.ts`
  - Entity extension of: `tasks/tasks-core` (table `conversations_ext_places_ask`)
  - Register:
    - `mcpTool('places_search_text')`
    - `mcpTool('places_show_picks')`
  - Resources: `places.ask.candidates:rows` (keyed, point)
- Core:
